significati.essoterico: Fertility, pleasure, material and emotional abundance. It points to gestation in the broad sense: projects that grow, relationships that flower, wellbeing and domestic harmony.
significati.psicologico: It embodies the ability to receive, nourish and enjoy life; the relationship with the body, with beauty and with the maternal principle.
significati.iniziatico: Path 14 from Chokmah to Binah, the letter Daleth (the door, 4) and Venus: the horizontal path joining the supreme Father and Mother. It is the door through which divine force becomes living form, the love that generates.
significati.ombra: Ill-dignified, it signals dissipation, luxury, possessiveness, emotional dependence or stagnation in comfort.

carta.dritto: A time of growth and fertility: what you tend will bear fruit. Make room for pleasure, creativity and generosity.
carta.rovescio: Fertility is blocked or turns into excess: indulgence, jealousy, care that smothers. Direct some of the nourishment back toward yourself.

ambiti.amore: A warm, sensual, nourishing relationship; a possible wish for family or for a new emotional beginning.
ambiti.lavoro: Creative and productive projects expanding, collaborative environments, earnings born of patient care.
ambiti.spirito: Nature as temple: the divine recognised in beauty and in generation.

carta.nota_crowley: Crowley links the Empress to the alchemical Salt and to the door of Daleth; at her feet the pelican feeds its young with its own blood, and on the shield the white eagle: mother and bride, form receiving force.

testo: A time of growth and fertility: what you tend will bear fruit. Make room for pleasure, creativity and generosity.
